title: Alicia Hale: Phoenix Police officials seek help in woman's murder
text:
It's been over four years since Alicia Hale was killed, and Phoenix Police investigators are asking for the public's help as they continue to investigate.
Phoenix Police officials are asking for the public's help, as they work to track down the person who allegedly shot and killed a woman in broad daylight.According to a statement released by Phoenix Police, 34-year-old Alisha Hale was shot and killed on June 3, 2021, and her body was left in a desert area near I-10 and Baseline Road.A never-before-seen video that was released on July 23 gives a timeline on Hale's murder.
Officials say their top priority is to find the suspect inside the truck."We believe that the suspect knew ," Sgt. Bower said.Judging from the video, they think the suspect is about 5’ 9", and the car is believed to be a 2005 or 2006 Dodge RAM with four doors. Detectives don';t have a license plate, but they hope a back tow hitch might be a distinctive clue.Investigators also noted on what Hale was wearing at the time."This is not her normal dress," said Sgt. Bower.
